response.rationale: The patient presents with classic symptoms of PID (lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting) along with laboratory evidence of infection (elevated WBC and CRP) and purulent fluid found during surgery. While an ovarian cyst with infection is present, PID encompasses the broader clinical picture including the systemic inflammatory response.
